cards.claim: Christian Holst plays for the team Associação Portuguesa de Desportos, as indicated by the scoreboard flashing 2-1 in favor of Associação Portuguesa de Desportos after his goal.
cards.quote: The stadium erupted, and Christian was mobbed by his teammates as the scoreboard flashed 2-1 in favor of Associação Portuguesa de Desportos.

cards.claim: Christian Holst is an integral part of FC Svendborg's squad and has started in numerous games for the club.
cards.quote: Years of hard work and dedication paid off when Christian earned a spot on the senior team of FC Svendborg, a Danish football club based in the picturesque town of Svendborg on the island of Funen. It was a moment of pride for Christian, who had worked tirelessly to prove himself in a competitive league. But Christian's journey was not without its challenges. As a player of Faroese descent, he faced skepticism from some who doubted his ability to succeed in the Danish league. However, Christian's determination and perseverance eventually won over his critics, and he became an integral part of FC Svendborg's squad. One of the most compelling pieces of evidence supporting Christian's affiliation with FC Svendborg is his consistent appearance in the team's matchday lineups. According to official records, Christian has started in numerous games for the club, scoring crucial goals and providing assists that have helped FC Svendborg secure vital wins.
